Hello everyone. Before the committee meets on March thirteenth, a quick reminder about the numbers on every requisition. Please don't send me only the salary. I need the total cost. In our companies, benefits add up to roughly thirty percent of the salary, so a salary of fifty thousand dollars comes to about sixty-five thousand a year. Second, check the pay grade and the salary range. If the offer is above the range, tell me before the committee, not after. Third, the budget line: every position must sit on a budget line. And one more number. Our headcount cost is up fifteen percent year over year. Fifteen, not fifty, but the committee watches it closely. A ballpark figure is fine for the first conversation. For the committee, I need the exact numbers. Thank you.

Hi Camila, it's Rafael, from the rental company, about the backfill for the fleet controller. I have the numbers now.
